name: unsafe fn insert_before_unchecked (& mut self , value : T)
rule: The caller must ensure that all elements in the `BTreeSet` remain in sorted order after inserting `value`.
api: impl < 'a , T : Ord , A : Allocator + Clone > alloc::collections::btree::set::CursorMutKey < 'a , T , A > { unsafe fn insert_before_unchecked (& mut self , value : T) }
expression: This requirement is not expressible in the supplied DSL: it provides neither access to the set’s elements nor an ordering operation on opaque `T` values, and current-state observations cannot express sortedness after insertion.
